SOCIAL STUDIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #6
====

GRADE: Grade 8
SUBJECT: SOCIAL STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Measure rainfall only
   B. Name the president
   C. Explain symbols used on a map
   D. Replace the compass rose

2. Which statement about Vegetation in Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Vegetation in Africa never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Vegetation in Africa as rumours only.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Vegetation in Africa.
   D. Explain Vegetation in Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

3. Which statement about Diversity and interpersonal skills is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Diversity and interpersonal skills as rumours only.
   B. Explain Diversity and interpersonal skills with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Diversity and interpersonal skills.
   D. Say Diversity and interpersonal skills never happens in Kenya.

4. Which statement about Self- Esteem Assessment is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Self- Esteem Assessment as rumours only.
   B. Say Self- Esteem Assessment never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Self- Esteem Assessment.
   D. Explain Self- Esteem Assessment with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

5. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Plan income and spending wisely
   B. Hide all money underground
   C. Avoid saving forever
   D. Ignore prices in shops

6. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Littering in markets
   B. Avoiding all community work
   C. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   D. Destroying road signs

7. Which statement about Map Reading and Interpretation is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Map Reading and Interpretation with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Map Reading and Interpretation never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Map Reading and Interpretation as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Map Reading and Interpretation.

8. Which statement about Scientific Theory about Human Origin is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Scientific Theory about Human Origin.
   B. Explain Scientific Theory about Human Origin with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Scientific Theory about Human Origin as rumours only.
   D. Say Scientific Theory about Human Origin never happens in Kenya.

9. Which statement about Trans Saharan Slave Trade is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Trans Saharan Slave Trade with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Trans Saharan Slave Trade never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Trans Saharan Slave Trade.
   D. Treat Trans Saharan Slave Trade as rumours only.

10. Which statement about Self- Improvement is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Self- Improvement as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Self- Improvement.
   C. Explain Self- Improvement with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Self- Improvement never happens in Kenya.

11. Which statement about Population Growth in Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Population Growth in Africa never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Population Growth in Africa as rumours only.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Population Growth in Africa.
   D. Explain Population Growth in Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

12. Which statement about Early Civilisation ● Asia, ● Europe is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Early Civilisation ● Asia, ● Europe never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Early Civilisation ● Asia, ● Europe as rumours only.
   C. Explain Early Civilisation ● Asia, ● Europe with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Early Civilisation ● Asia, ● Europe.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Diversity and interpersonal skills and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Peaceful Conflict Resolution ● Negotiation ● Mediation ● Arbitration and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Map Reading and Interpretation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Weather and Climate ● Desert ● Semi-desert ● Tropical ● Mediterranean ● Mountain and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
